what_this_is: The rails shipped with tools/guard-ai-spending, as DATA a person replaces: a person's own payment-rail record with the same id takes the place of a row here. Every rail ships disabled. A rail is valid only when its guard is tool:reserve-a-spend-within-budget and its ledger is tool:record-a-spend. Its credential_ref names the held key; the key itself is never here.

metadata.settlement_note: No Workshop tool settles an x402 payment yet, so this rail stays disabled until one exists.
